description: Search what is for sale or rent in Vietnam on this marketplace: apartments and rooms, motorbikes and cars, electronics, furniture, jobs, services and more. Words can include a district ("2 bedroom apartment district 7", "căn hộ quận 2"). Returns up to 20 live listings with price in VND and a link to each listing's page, where the person sees the photos and contacts the seller.

category.description: A category slug from list_categories, e.g. "rentals", "vehicles", "electronics"

condition.description: Item condition: "new" (includes like_new items) or "used"; other values do not filter

offset.description: Skip this many results, for the next page (up to 200)

province.description: City or province name, e.g. "Ho Chi Minh", "Ha Noi", "Da Nang"

q.description: What to look for, in English or Vietnamese; a district or area in the words narrows to it

sort.description: "best" (the default) ranks by relevance and freshness; "recent" is newest first

subcategory.description: A subcategory slug of that category, from list_categories

type.description: What the listing offers: for sale, for rent, a job, or a wanted ad

name: search_listings

capped.description: true when more listings match but this server only pages through the first 220: narrow the search instead

items.description: One listing: id, title, price, price_unit, negotiable, listing_type, condition, location, district, city, category, subcategory, image, posted_at, sponsored, url

id.description: Listing id; pass it to get_listing_details

sponsored.description: true for a paid or commission listing; say so when you show it

url.description: The listing's page on the site: send the person there to see photos and contact the seller

next_offset.description: Pass as `offset` for more results; null when there are no more, or when `capped` is true

total.description: About how many live listings match on the site

title: Search listings
